title: Move Readback
description: Stops a move from quietly changing who can see something: it reads back the destination path with the folder that sets access highlighted, says how many people gain or lose access ("Moving into Public makes it visible to 40 people"), counts path links that will break with a one-tap redirect, lists inherited settings that change, and relabels the button when the move widens the audience.
stops: Private doc moved into public folder
